fn check(e : Expr, columns : List(Column), allow : Bool, inside : Bool) : Expr =
  if e.op == "col" then
    let matches = filter(
        \(c) -> c.name == e.name && (e.qualifier == "" || e.qualifier == c.qualifier),
        columns,
      )
    demand(length(matches) > 0, "UNKNOWN_COLUMN")
    demand(length(matches) == 1, "AMBIGUOUS_COLUMN")
    let c = at(matches, 0)
    Expr { ..e, index = c.index, source = c.source, kind = c.kind }
  elif e.op == "lit" then
    e
  else
    let isagg = agg(e.op)
    demand(not(isagg) || allow && not(inside), "INVALID_AGGREGATION")
    let args = map(\(a) -> check(a, columns, allow, inside || isagg), e.args)
    let ts = map(\(a) -> a.kind, args)
    let kind =
      if e.op == "COUNT" then
        "int"
      elif elem(e.op, ["SUM", "+", "-", "*"]) then
        demand(all(\(t) -> t == "int", ts), "TYPE_ERROR")
        "int"
      elif elem(e.op, ["MIN", "MAX"]) then
        demand(elem(at(ts, 0), ["int", "text"]), "TYPE_ERROR")
        at(ts, 0)
      elif elem(e.op, ["NOT", "AND", "OR"]) then
        demand(all(\(t) -> t == "bool", ts), "TYPE_ERROR")
        "bool"
      else
        demand(
            at(ts, 0) == at(ts, 1)
              && (at(ts, 0) /= "bool" || elem(e.op, ["=", "<>"])),
            "TYPE_ERROR",
          )
        "bool"
    Expr { ..e, args = args, kind = kind }

fn evaluate(e : Expr, row : List(Json), group : List(List(Json))) : Json =
  let op = e.op
  if op == "lit" then
    e.value
  elif op == "col" then
    at(row, e.index)
  elif agg(op) then
    if op == "COUNT" then
      JInt(length(group))
    else
      let vs = map(\(r) -> evaluate(at(e.args, 0), r, []), group)
      if op == "SUM" then
        JInt(sum(map(integer, vs)))
      else
        extremum(vs, op == "MIN")
  else
    let a = evaluate(at(e.args, 0), row, group)
    if op == "NOT" then
      JBool(not(truth(a)))
    else
      let b = evaluate(at(e.args, 1), row, group)
      if op == "+" then
        JInt(integer(a) + integer(b))
      elif op == "-" then
        JInt(integer(a) - integer(b))
      elif op == "*" then
        JInt(integer(a) * integer(b))
      elif op == "AND" then
        JBool(truth(a) && truth(b))
      elif op == "OR" then
        JBool(truth(a) || truth(b))
      else
        let c = compare_value(a, b)
        JBool(
            if op == "=" then c == 0 elif op == "<>" then c /= 0 elif op == "<" then c < 0 elif op == ">" then c > 0 elif op == "<=" then c <= 0 else c >= 0,
          )

fn evaluate(e : Expr, row : List(Json), group : List(List(Json))) : Json =
  let op = e.op
  if op == "lit" then
    e.value
  elif op == "col" then
    at(row, e.index)
  elif agg(op) then
    if op == "COUNT" then
      if length(e.args) == 0 then JInt(length(group)) else JInt(length(filter(\(r) -> not(null_value(evaluate(at(e.args, 0), r, []))), group)))
    else
      let vs = filter(\(v) -> not(null_value(v)), map(\(r) -> evaluate(at(e.args, 0), r, []), group))
      if op == "SUM" then
        JInt(sum(map(integer, vs)))
      else
        extremum(vs, op == "MIN")
  else
    let a = evaluate(at(e.args, 0), row, group)
    if op == "NOT" then
      match a of
        JNull => JNull
        _ => JBool(not(truth(a)))
    elif op == "ISNULL" then
      JBool(null_value(a))
    elif op == "ISNOTNULL" then
      JBool(not(null_value(a)))
    elif op == "COALESCE" then
      coalesce(e.args, row, group)
    else
      let b = evaluate(at(e.args, 1), row, group)
      if op == "AND" then
        and_value(a, b)
      elif op == "OR" then
        or_value(a, b)
      elif null_value(a) || null_value(b) then
        JNull
      elif op == "+" then
        JInt(integer(a) + integer(b))
      elif op == "-" then
        JInt(integer(a) - integer(b))
      elif op == "*" then
        JInt(integer(a) * integer(b))
      else
        let c = compare_value(a, b)
        JBool(
            if op == "=" then c == 0 elif op == "<>" then c /= 0 elif op == "<" then c < 0 elif op == ">" then c > 0 elif op == "<=" then c <= 0 else c >= 0,
          )

  r : List(Json),
  rows : List(List(Json)),
  order : List((Int, Bool))
) : List(List(Json)) =
  match rows of
    Nil => [r]
    Cons(x, rest) =>

        Cons(r, rows)
      else
        Cons(x, insert_row(r, rest, order))

fn row_compare(
  a : List(Json),
  b : List(Json),
  order : List((Int, Bool))
) : Int =
  match order of
    Nil => 0
    Cons((i, desc), rest) =>
      let c = compare_value(at(a, i), at(b, i))
      if c == 0 then
        row_compare(a, b, rest)
      elif desc then
        -c
      else
        c

fn row_compare(
  a : List(Json),
  b : List(Json),
  order : List((Int, Bool, Bool))
) : Int =
  match order of
    Nil => 0
    Cons((i, desc, null_first), rest) =>
      if null_value(at(a, i)) && null_value(at(b, i)) then
        row_compare(a, b, rest)
      elif null_value(at(a, i)) then
        if null_first then -1 else 1
      elif null_value(at(b, i)) then
        if null_first then 1 else -1
      else
        let c = compare_value(at(a, i), at(b, i))
        if c == 0 then row_compare(a, b, rest) elif desc then -c else c

fn validate_column(j : Json) : Column =
  fields(j, ["name", "type", "nullable"])
  let n = text(getfield(j, "name"))
  let t = text(getfield(j, "type"))
  demand(name_ok(n) && elem(t, ["int", "text", "bool"]), "INVALID_INPUT")
  let nullable = match getfield(j, "nullable") of
    JBool(b) => b
    _ =>
      reject("INVALID_INPUT")
      false
  Column {
    name = n,
    kind = t,
    qualifier = "",
    source = 0,
    index = 0,
    nullable = nullable
  }

fn expression(minimum : Int) : Expr =
  let t = pop()
  let w = t.word
  demand(not(elem(w, ["NULL", "COALESCE"])), "UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE")
  let e =
    if w == "NOT" then
      node(w, [expression(3)])
    elif w == "(" then
      let x = expression(1)
      expect(")")
      x
    elif w == "-" then
      literal(JInt(-natural()))
    elif elem(w, ["NUMBER", "LITERAL"]) then
      literal(t.value)
    elif elem(w, ["TRUE", "FALSE"]) then
      literal(JBool(w == "TRUE"))
    elif agg(w) then
      expect("(")
      let args =
        if w == "COUNT" && accept("*") then
          []
        else
          [expression(1)]
      expect(")")
      node(w, args)
    else
      demand(name_ok(w), "PARSE_ERROR")
      if accept(".") then
        column_ref(w, name())
      else
        column_ref("", w)
  binary(e, minimum, false)

fn expression(minimum : Int) : Expr =
  let t = pop()
  let w = t.word
  let e =
    if w == "NOT" then
      node(w, [expression(3)])
    elif w == "(" then
      let x = expression(1)
      expect(")")
      x
    elif w == "-" then
      literal(JInt(-natural()))
    elif elem(w, ["NUMBER", "LITERAL"]) then
      literal(t.value)
    elif elem(w, ["TRUE", "FALSE"]) then
      literal(JBool(w == "TRUE"))
    elif w == "NULL" then
      literal(JNull)
    elif w == "COALESCE" then
      expect("(")
      let first = expression(1)
      expect(",")
      let second = expression(1)
      let rest = coalesce_tail()
      expect(")")
      node("COALESCE", append([first, second], rest))
    elif agg(w) then
      expect("(")
      let args =
        if w == "COUNT" && accept("*") then
          []
        else
          [expression(1)]
      expect(")")
      node(w, args)
    else
      demand(name_ok(w), "PARSE_ERROR")
      if accept(".") then
        column_ref(w, name())
      else
        column_ref("", w)
  binary(e, minimum, false)

fn query() : Query =
  expect("SELECT")
  let distinct = accept("DISTINCT")
  let sels = selections()
  expect("FROM")
  let (ss, js) = join_sources([source()], [])
  let pred =
    if accept("WHERE") then
      expression(1)
    else
      literal(JBool(true))
  let groups =
    if accept("GROUP") then
      expect("BY")
      group_keys()
    else
      []
  let hh = accept("HAVING")
  let hav =
    if hh then
      expression(1)
    else
      literal(JBool(true))
  let order =
    if accept("ORDER") then
      expect("BY")
      order_keys()
    else
      []
  let lim =
    if accept("LIMIT") then
      natural()
    else
      -1
  let off =
    if lim >= 0 && accept("OFFSET") then
      natural()
    else
      0
  let ignored = accept(";")
  demand(peek() == "$END", "PARSE_ERROR")
  Query {
    select = sels,
    sources = ss,
    joins = js,
    predicate = pred,
    groups = groups,
    having = hav,
    has_having = hh,
    order = order,
    distinct = distinct,
    limit = lim,
    offset = off
  }
